english: Forgive me. I will never forget the debt of a night's lodging and a meal.
Don't worry about stuff like that!
No, that won't satisfy me.\nI swear I'll find\nthat rabbit of yours!
I'm glad you'll help, but!\nWe've got zero leads, y'know~.
Aren't rabbits\nthings found in fields?
You think there are normal rabbits around here?
There aren't!?
Like I said yesterday, in this Kyouto place,\nweird is normal.\nThough the food's normal, I guess?
I can believe that.\nShady-looking things stroll down the main street\nlike it's nothing...
You were so on edge, Houki-san!\nLike, 'is this thing gonna attack me!?'
Of course I was on guard!\nMy world has\nno such bizarre people in it.
Good point!
By the way, why are you looking for the rabbit?
It's like... that's the whole point, kinda?
You're not making much sense...\nAnyway, I just need to find the rabbit, right?
Yeah! But I've been searching every day\nand haven't found a thing.
If there are no normal rabbits...
(Come to think of it, there are strange people\nwearing rabbit ears on their heads...\nMy sister, for one)
Hm-hm-hmm~♪
Hey! What about that one!?\nBlack or not,\nit kinda looks like a rabbit!
Huh, which one?
Ah, it ran! Wait!!
It's not exactly a proper black rabbit...\nbut screw it, chase first, think later!
Where'd it go? It's a fast runner~.
Is this okay, Koto?\nLooks like we've wandered into youkai territory.
The rabbit matters more! C'mon, that way!
Are you sure...?
I'm exhausted...
Get it together!\nYou're a Representative Candidate, aren't you!
Even so...\neverywhere we go it's crawling with monsters,\nI never get a moment's rest~.
Ufu, ufufu, ufufufufu,\nit's a lovely paradise~.
[MERU]-san,\nyou really like this stuff, huh~.
Unyuu!\nI wanna raise every single one in my garden!
We see human-looking ones too,\nbut I've no idea which are dangerous\nand which are safe...
In times like these, you're on recon duty.
M-me?
You're the one here who looks most like\none of the monsters' pals!\nAt least earn your keep for once!
Miss Aria is right. Get to work!
And whose fault is it I look monstrous...
What?\nTrying to say it's MY fault?
N-no, nothing...\nBut I don't really know what kind of thing\nI should talk to...
Anything's fine! If it's got a mouth and ears\nit can talk, right!?
Is that really true...
Maybe their mouths are eating-only.
Hey!? Don't say scary stuff!
...It seems that won't be necessary.
Huh?
Looks like we got surrounded without noticing.
Eeeh!?
They say people long ago feared trees swaying\nin the night wind, thinking they were youkai -\nmaybe some of them really were!
My!\nNoel-san, you affirm the existence of youkai!?
Affirm or not, they're right in front of us...
Fufu-fu~n♪
Waaait!!
Mm!?
That's-!
It's Houki-chan!
Houki-cha~n! Over here!
You guys!?
Houki-san! You were safe!?
Huh? You know Houki-san?
Talk later! First, we exterminate youkai!
Right, sorry to spring this on you,\nbut catch that rabbit-like one\nover there!
Huh, a rabbit?
The rabbit-like one... that?
La-la-la-la-la~!\nI~♪ am sooo cute~♪\na bu-unny~♪
Wh... what...!?
A bunny~♪ or not a bunny~♪\nthat's a seeecret~♪
Rabbit or whatever,\nthat's a person, right?
Dunno.
What IS that!?
'Cause I'm cuuute~♪ that's fine, right~♪ Sparkle☆
...Guess I'll ventilate her for now.
Wait! My benefactor has business with that one!\nAnyway... please.
Alright! Now we can catch it!
Raaabbit!!
O-ho-ho-ho!
What was that laugh...
That's definitely a person, right...?
Pardon me~♪
What was that!?
I've seen that before!
Just like Riko...!
It's vanished.
Um, does that mean... break time?
Looks like we can catch our breath.
So that one really was the right one...
Nothing to be done once it's vanished.
Houki-san!!
Mm... Cecilia.
I was worried, you know?\nYou weren't tortured or anything?
Huh?
Weren't you captured by the enemy?\nGasp, a desperate great escape!?
No, not really...
Houki-chaaaaan!!
Uwaah!? I-it's out!!\nStop it, and quit calling me Houki-chan!
What the hell!? With that cool face\nlike nothing happened!\nMakes us look like idiots for worrying!
Ufufu, you really were worried.
What? Something wrong with that?
No, not at all.\nYou're kind, Aria-san.
I-it's normal... that stuff!
Wow, are all these Houki-san's friends?
No, these people are...
We're friends!
That's right! Houki-chan's friends!
What... no, first off, drop the '-chan'!
For me she'd be a classmate -\na school friend, that is.
Then for me she'd be a schoolmate?
Who are you?
Wh-!? Hey!\nYou've seen my IS, haven't you!
What I don't know, I don't know!
Now now, Rinin-chan's introduction can wait -\nis that girl from this world?
I'm Koto!\nI live in this Kyouto, technically!
She saved me in a tight spot, and took care of me\nwith food and a bed. She's my benefactor.
That's fine, don't worry about it.
Oh, right!\nIf you're Houki-san's friends, you've got nowhere to go, yeah?\nCome to my place!
That's wonderful!\nLast night we camped out with zero preparation,\nit was miserable...
Okay, after all that rampaging\nI'm hungry too,\nso let's eat at my place!
Agreed!
Agreed!
Totally agreed!
Okay, so... huh?\nWhat time is it? This sunlight...
What's with this light!?
I wonder if there's any pattern to this...
Hm? What?
Th-this is way too sudden!
Who's pulling this off -\nwhat kind of master magician!?
Sis...
Yes, the plan had some changes,\nbut it seems we've corrected back on schedule.
Koto vanished HERE? Impossible...\nIt can't be!
Thank you for contacting us, Yase-douji.
...Arrived.
That was fast.
I thought we might be summoned soon,\nso I kept nearby.
What is this...?\nNo one should be able to leave Kyouto!\nIf Koto's disappearance is your doing...!
No.
As for those who took\nthat girl Koto,\nI can't say I don't know.
I'll bring Koto back myself!\nShe's precious to me!\nWhere are the ones who kidnapped Koto!
Forgive me, Yase-douji, but do you have\nany means of leaving this world?
...I see. So that's how it is.
...What do you want? Say it.
(So that was the plan from the start...)
Huh? We came back here?
Where in the world is this?
Houki-chan hadn't been here?\nUm, well...
Whoa! So this ISN'T Kyouto!
At least,\nit's not where you were, Koto-chan.
Houki, your home isn't here either.
I can tell that much.\n...Hmph.
Where are you going?
None of your business.
What's with her!?
With this much change in environment,\nit's normal to feel unsettled.
Are you saying I'm insensitive?
No, that's not what I-
Just kidding!\nI can go anywhere with one bag,\nand I sleep like a log even with a different pillow!
Wonderful adaptability.
Haah... I miss my bed and pillow~.
There's another one weak to change.
W-weak, what do you mean!?\nWhen the bedding changes I just drop a little\nbelow peak condition, that's all!
Yeah, yeah.
I'm fine anywhere too!\nAs long as the food's good!
Leave the cooking to me!\nI'm great at Chinese food!
Really!? Can't wait!
I can cook too!\nI make bentos all the time,\nand Aoi-chan vouches for the taste!
Yes. Haruka-san's hamburger steaks\nand fried shrimp are delicious.\nHer rolled omelets are exquisite!
Amazing! Fancier than my place's food!
Koto-chan, like I said before,\nwe're investigating this unexplained travel\nand looking for a way back to our world.
I think it'd be best if you stuck\nwith us for a while -\nis that okay?
Sure, sure!\nLooks like I'll get to eat tons of yummy stuff!
I wish you'd share\nsome of that easygoing-ness with Houki.
Worrying is a young person's job too, or so they say.\nRight, Sonico?
W-wah! Y-yes!
This group has a lot of mentally tough kids...\nnot that I can talk.
...What am I even doing...!
After running wild on my own,\nI had to take Mine Riko's pity!\nAnd dragged so many people into this...!
And yet... I can't do a damn thing!\nI'm just a huge idiot!!
Houki-chan... I should've called out to her.
Hibiki-chan, don't worry so much.\nSometimes people want to be left alone.
Is that right...?
It's okay. Let's give her a little more time.
You're kind, Haruka-chan.\nI've still got a long way to go...
Ahaha, I've got a long way to go too!\nAoi-chan's way kinder than me!
Yeah, I can believe that.
Oh, Houki-san.\nHave you seen Hibiki-san and Haruka-san?
Hm? Hibiki and Haruka?
We're about to discuss\nour plans going forward.\nPlease tell us all about Kyouto, Houki-san.
...I'll tell you what I know,\nbut I'm the one who caused everyone trouble.\nI have no right to join the discussion.
To help someone,\ndo you need qualifications?
Huh...
Not someone helping someone -\nlet's all help each other.\nIsn't now that kind of time?
You don't need qualifications.\nAs long as you have the heart,\nyou can help each other.
...Heart, huh.
I want to help you, Houki-san.\nBut all I can do\nis call on Blue Angel.
Does someone as powerless as me\nhave no right to help you, Houki-san?
That's not true! That's not-!
You can do more than I can, Houki-san,\nso have confidence. When you're anxious,\njust think of me anytime.
Urgh...\num... th-thank...
Houki-chaaan!!
Huh, Haruka!? Were you watching!?
We said we'd just watch over her,\nbut Haruka-chan... ahaha.
Hibiki too!! What is this!!
I'll help Houki-chan too!\nAnd I'll have Houki-chan help me!
Me too!
Keep your voices down!!\nWhat if the others gather!
That's right, Haruka-san, Hibiki-san.\nLet's keep this just between us.\nHouki-san's shy... right?
Got it. Sorry, Houki-chan.
Sorry... I just got happy.
...It's fine.
But... I feel like a weight's lifted.\nI will repay this kindness.
Then let me call you Houki-chan!
Th-that... I've already forgiven you, haven't I.
Yay! I can too, right?
I-it's only 'cause I have no choice, no choice...
Everyone's here.\nThen I have a proposal.\nHear me out.
Right now we're experiencing a phenomenon where\na mysterious light flings us to various worlds...\nThe cause is unknown, right?
The cause is unknown, right?
Yes.\nSo to figure out the cause and mechanism,\nwe have to take some kind of action.
Do you have a plan?
Considering everything so far,\nAria-chan and I thought it through together.
Once before, we were acting separately,\nbut we regrouped in Dokoka Town.\nThose who remember, remember, right?
That's when I first met Aria-chan!
Right. That bugs me.\nThe timing was too good for coincidence.
And one more thing:\nonly when leaving this Dokoka Town\ndo we move at a time of our choosing.
Could we just stay\nin this town forever?
I kinda feel like we shouldn't overstay our welcome...\nor can we?
When I went to Kyouto with Mine Riko,\nwe never came to a town like this.\nI wonder if there's a reason for that too?
The residents of this town - just two people in a shop - are a mystery too.
But they're both lovely girls, you know~!
At least, thanks to Dokoka Town,\nthere are ways we've been helped.\nAntagonizing them would be unwise.
Yeah yeah. I wanna stay friends!
So what are you and Aria\nplanning?
Let's split up the members here once,\nand test whether we can regroup here\nagain.
Everyone made a Dokoka Card, right?\nThen even separated, you should reach Dokoka Town.\nEven if we get scattered.
I see.\nSo we might learn something\nlike a pattern from that?
But aren't there risks?
True. Splitting our numbers is dangerous too.
But unless we figure out\nhow this travel works,\nmy gut says something decisively bad will happen eventually.
Same here.\nI've got a bad feeling... like\nthis can't go on.
So here's the proposal.\nHow about splitting into 3 groups?
3 groups...? I see, but...
It's the bare minimum line for handling combat.\nI'd rather split further, honestly.
So you want to increase the sample cases\nand gather data.
If we make 3 groups,\nhow about me, Cecilia, and Houki split up?
Then I'll go with Houki-chan!
I wanna be with Houki-san too.
You guys... is that okay?
Then I'll go with Cecilia-chan!\nUm, how would that be?!
Oh, that's fine.
Then Rem and I will team with Rinin.
Is it decided that Rem and Aria are together?
It's easier to discuss things together.
I'll join Cecilia-chan's group\nand throw myself in front, maybe?
We've split neatly into threes.\nI'll... (thinking about combat balance...)\nlet me join you, Cecilia-san.
Rinin, me, Rem, and\nHouki, Haruka, Koto,\nCecilia, Hibiki, Sonico, Aoi - 3 groups.
What about [MERU]?
I'll follow\n[CLAUDE]-kun!
What about [NOEL]?
[CLAUDE]-kun's\nstill here, so.\nI'll support [CLAUDE]-kun.
Sound judgment.
I'm sorry...
We'd be in trouble if you got lost, you know.
Well, we're stuck with each other, for better or worse!
So, which group are you joining?
Decided.
Team assignments complete!\nUm, departure is...
Each team leaves Dokoka Town two hours apart.\nThat'll tell us first whether each team's destination\nis the same or scattered.
What do we do after that?
We'll set a max number of days;\npast that, wait in Dokoka Town.\nThat should let us regroup. In theory.
Aoi-chan, we're splitting up, but... let's do our best!
Haruka-san...
I know, Aoi-chan.\nI believe we'll definitely meet again.
Yes.
Cecilia! Houki!\nProtect everyone properly!
Have you forgotten who I am?\nThis Cecilia Alcott is perfect!
Except for missing your pillow, right.
We're not talking about that!!
Koto, Haruka - even if this body rots away,\nI will protect you...!
Geez, you're way too tense!
Yeah yeah. Houki-san, loosen up!\nBeing serious is your good point, though.
Even so,\nI can't change that easily.\nI'm... clumsy, y'know...
That's fine, though.\nRight, Koto-chan?
Exactlyyy!
I'm sorry...
Okay, I've gotta try harder in the next shoot!\n...Hiyah!!
With Sonico-san around,\nanywhere would be fun!\nNice to meet you!
Yes, Hibiki-san.\nCecilia-san, nice to meet you too.
With me here you needn't worry about a thing!\nRest easy like you're aboard a great ship\nthe size of the Titanic!
(That ship sank, though...)
Everyone,\nif you meet [NOEL],\nplease tell her to come along!
Everyone, if [MERU]'s around,\ngrab her and bring her here!
So you were worried about each other.
I-it's nothing!\nBut, y'know, the more useless\nthe little sister, the cuter!
Th-that's not true!\nBut she's like\na spoiled little sister...
Then, everyone prepare to depart.\nDon't let your guard down!
//END
